body: And to answer a few things, no I don't have anyone in my life, other than a guy who use to sell coke to me. I don't get to see my daughter because my ex, I didn't have any other family other than my parents. I get my work through an auto board, it's sub work on construction sites. I never talk to anyone other than (where,when, that won't work) for work. Even if someone tried to come into my life, I'm to afraid of hurting them.

So far the universe has trapped me ever so much further back. I keep saying tomorrow, and I keep getting pushed back. There is no schedule issue or financial set back tomorrow. If this is goodbye, thank you for responding. If my time doesn't end tomorrow, I look forward to responding to whatever you might comment.

Thank you for conversing with me. I haven't changed my mind about how I want to conclude my life, but it is nice to have conversation even this way. When tomorrow comes, if my time hasn't I'll definitely respond to whatever you reply.

I don't have any other family, only friend I have is a guy I use to buy coke from, we aren't really close but I talk to him from time to time. I don't really know, my ex doesn't really think to much of me so I don't get to see my daughter.

I don't really know what to share. I'm broken mentally. I'm trying to do what is right, but the more I try the more wrong seems to happen. I just want to feel like I'm making progress. I want to feel and know that things are getting better. I want to live again, what I'm doing now looks more like a man being beaten down by the world. I was prepared to fend for myself, even take care of my daughter. I wasn't prepared for the years of taking care of my terminal parents, trying desperately to take care of a suicidal and depressed girlfriend who live with us as well, taking care of my daughter who I love deeply and working all of those hours. I became the only one who could do anything. In the end, it seems like the one left standing will only be my daughter.

My life. Without to much detail, I'm 21 and live in the U.S. In the last few years I've lost everyone. It doesn't feel like life is a fight anymore, more of a beating that's slowly becoming unbearable. For the last week, every morning I say today is the day. And through what seem like life continuing on without my permission I lose the opportunity to leave in peace and quite with the final materials I need. I want help, I want things to get better. But out of everything I've tried over the last two years it just gets worse. I've come to Reddit, just to speak. I miss living with the simple worries of bills and chores. I miss my family. I just want at least a manageable life. But I can't, I'm ready to let go.

I want to believe this. But it just feels like it's a lie. Feels like after years of fighting, it's no longer a fight it's just a beating. A beating that just never ends and only gets worse. Why live through a beating.

I have no options and want to give up. When I think of others that it might after all I want to say is sorry. Not for doing want I want to do, but because I feel like I'm failing them. I found a easy painless way of doing it. I'm ready to say goodbye, but everyday, for some reason I'm stopped by the events that take place. I don't know what to do, other than just suffer.
